rows.note: Use 邪惡 as the all-purpose choice for someone or something morally evil or reprehensible.

example.english: They betrayed their own friend for money; they’re truly wicked.
example.traditional: 佢為咗錢出賣自己個朋友，真係好邪惡。
example.jyutping: keoi5 wai6 zo2 cin4 ceot1 maai6 zi6 gei2 go3 pang4 jau5 zan1 hai6 hou2 ce4 ok3

rows.note: Use 惡劣 especially for harsh or severe weather, conditions, or circumstances.

example.english: The weather has been so wicked lately that all the flights have had to be cancelled.
example.traditional: 呢排天氣咁惡劣，班機全部都要取消。
example.jyutping: ni1 paai4 tin1 hei3 gam3 ok3 lyut3 baan1 gei1 cyun4 bou6 dou1 jiu3 ceoi2 siu1

rows.note: Use colloquial 正 for something excellent, awesome, or impressively done.

example.english: You made this cake really wicked!
example.traditional: 你整呢個蛋糕整得真係正！
example.jyutping: nei5 zing2 ni1 go3 daan6 gou1 zing2 dak1 zan1 hai6 zing3
